name: Homelessness
overview: Scripture reveals a clear call to honor God by showing mercy to the poor and homeless, emphasizing that kindness to them is as if lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such deeds. Believers are urged to provide for the hungry, the naked, and those cast out, welcoming strangers and not turning away from those in need. Jesus Himself experienced homelessness, highlighting the humility and sacrifice of the Son of Man. Those who give generously to the poor are assured they will not lack, while neglect and oppression of the needy bring reproach and curse.
